svg.title: Naresh Kumar: GPU cluster networking, distributed systems and secure AI infrastructure
svg.desc: A GPU cluster is only as fast as its slowest link, as reliable as its weakest node and as safe as its least-watched path. An animated ring of eight GPUs loses a link, every rank times out, the culprit is named and the job restores onto a spare and resumes; then an unattested host tries to join the communicator and is denied while training continues. A terminal line narrates each step and a goodput bar records the cost.
svg.text: GPU NETWORKING · DISTRIBUTED SYSTEMS · SECURE AI INFRA
A GPU cluster is only as fast as its
slowest link, as reliable as its weakest
node, and as safe as its least-watched
path. I build for all three.
Find the one broken part. Recover the cheapest safe way.
RDMA · RoCE · NCCL · DPDK · SR-IOV · KVM · eBPF · zero trust

g.text: $ goodput watch --job llm-512 step 41,207 · 512/512 ranks healthy · fabric clean
! rank 3 stopped posting sends · the ring stalls hop by hop · no error anywhere yet
! nccl watchdog: ALLREDUCE seq=88213 timed out on 8/8 ranks · every rank looks guilty
→ culprit: rank 3 · mlx5_2/1 link_downed=1, symbol_err ↑ · swap → spare, peer-ckpt restore
✓ resumed at step 41,200 · one node replaced, no full-job restart
✗ denied: unattested host tried to join the communicator · no workload identity · logged
$ goodput watch --job llm-512 step 41,388 · 512/512 ranks healthy · fabric clean
